title: Raptors' Collin Murray-Boyles exits vs. Wizards due to illness
text:
Raptors' Collin Murray-Boyles exits vs. Wizards due to illness - Sportsnet.ca 
 Loading... Raptors' Collin Murray-Boyles exits vs. Wizards due to illness
 Sportsnet Staff @Sportsnet November 18, 2026 - 9:32pm Toronto Raptors' Collin Murray-Boyles looks on during an NBA Cup basketball game against the Milwaukee Bucks, Friday, Nov. 6, 2026, in Milwaukee. (Aaron Gash/AP) 
 Already severely shorthanded, the Toronto Raptors saw another player sidelined Wednesday night. 
 Forward Collin Murray-Boyles exited the Raptors' game against the Washington Wizards due to illness, it was announced midway through the second quarter.
 Murray-Boyles started for Toronto, but played only four minutes before being subbed out and did not to the contest. He finished with one point, two rebounds and one assist in his short stint.
 The 21-year-old has been key for the Raptors as they try to stay alive down several players. In 13 games this season, the sophomore is averaging 9.9 points, 4.8 rebounds, 1.8 assists, 1.1 steals and 1.2 blocks while defending top assignments. 
 Shortly before Wednesday's game, the Raptors ruled out guard RJ Barrett (hamstring) and forward Scottie Barnes (groin injury management). Kawhi Leonard has also been missing from the starting lineup as he continues to manage left knee swelling.
